record.purpose: Find the relevant county office and verify incumbent and jurisdiction before any correspondence. This is not a confirmed separate recipient.

sources.source_title: Published county office, State Bar or public legal record contact
sources.stated_purpose: County legal administrative correspondence only where relevant to the actual office remit and jurisdiction.
sources.limitations: Current State Bar professional profile identifies the county office and email. County board resolution text identifies the appointment beginning January 27, 2026; no former officeholder address substituted. County counsel represents the county, not a private complainant. Do not infer independent complaint intake, legal filing or service-of-process authorization. Confirm address and remit before use; deliverability not tested.
